author: Abdelhalim Talbi

classification.method: Rule-based reclassification from the terminal exception signature plus test identity; traceback source excerpts are deliberately excluded from version/source-root-cause decisions. Counts cross-checked against the 225 FAIL/ERROR headings and final unittest summary.

categories.evidence: 50 import/test-module errors such as ModuleNotFoundError for modules expected under 03-Sources; the historical command did not consistently put that source root on PYTHONPATH.
categories.next_fix: Run from repository root with 03-Sources on PYTHONPATH; retain all import tests.

categories.evidence: 100 failures/errors refer to absent source/build files under 04-Tests-et-Qualification, including desktop.py, storagescope_windows.py, decision_workspace_ui_v543.py, StorageScope.iss and VERSION.
categories.next_fix: Centralize repository-root discovery and resolve source/build paths from that root.

categories.evidence: Windows WinError 32/PermissionError prevented cleanup of temporary SQLite database files while handles were still open.
categories.next_fix: Close connection owners deterministically; retain ResourceWarning-as-error checks.

categories.evidence: The PNG graph export test raised RuntimeError: PNG export requires Pillow.
categories.next_fix: Declare/install Pillow in the Windows test dependency set or explicitly test the documented optional-dependency rejection; do not silently skip the test.

categories.evidence: 29 assertions in version/manifest/release tests use older literal expectations (for example canonical 6.108 versus cycle-specific 6.87); classification uses the terminal assertion and test identity, not arbitrary source excerpts.
categories.next_fix: Read canonical VERSION or explicit compatibility contract; do not bump product VERSION solely to silence old tests.

categories.evidence: Four ValueError: substring not found errors and nine assertions over historical source strings/keywords; these are contract drift signals and require behavioral confirmation before changing source or tests.
categories.next_fix: Replace brittle text-only checks with behavior/contract checks after verifying rollback, hash-before-promotion and exit-code semantics.

categories.evidence: Two structural fixture errors: Invalid PE section count and Entry module absent.
categories.next_fix: Generate minimally valid deterministic PE/portable fixtures for positive cases while retaining malformed-fixture rejection tests.

categories.evidence: Thirteen build/packaging/native-qualification failures remain for individual manual review; this category is deliberately unresolved.
categories.next_fix: Review all 13 test IDs individually against the current build/qualification contract; keep them open until each root cause is linked to a corrective commit.

limitations: Heuristic first-pass classification from the historical job log; it is not proof that any later code change fixed each individual symptom.
No UnicodeDecodeError/UnicodeEncodeError signature appeared in this log; this is not a general guarantee about encoding.
The canonical product version remains 6.108; V6.236 is a development-cycle label.

artifact_evidence.limitation: The artifact only contained a qualification JSON reporting missing native evidence; the detailed classification came from the job log.

follow_up_state_as_of_2026_10_25.note: Later workflow/code changes address several root classes, but the old run was not re-executed and every original symptom is not linked individually to a later corrective commit.
